name: io.github.spranab/truenas-mcp
description: Manage TrueNAS SCALE from an AI agent — 278 actions across 18 categories behind one hierarchical MCP tool (~200 tokens of context instead of ~28k). Destructive operations require explicit confirmation.

environmentVariables.name: TRUENAS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from TrueNAS UI: Settings > API Keys > Add

environmentVariables.name: TRUENAS_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to skip SSL verification for self-signed certs (default: true)
